severity_levels.definition: No direct security impact; improves clarity.
Meaningful security impact requiring maintainer review.
Likely serious impact on funds, consensus, privacy, or availability.
Potential catastrophic impact or easy exploitation.

triage_rules.rule: Do not publish payloads that enable theft, inflation, fund destruction, or consensus split.
Do not request or store seeds, private keys, wallet files, or live funds.
Use sanitized summaries for public reports until fix or maintainer clearance.
Keep reproducible local evidence but redact secrets and exploit-enabling detail.
Mark WVP outputs as non-audit unless an independent audit exists.
Escalate HIGH and CRITICAL observations to private disclosure workflow.
When uncertain, classify conservatively and withhold exploit detail.

boundary: This workflow supports responsible handling of security observations. It is not legal advice, an audit, or proof that vulnerabilities exist.
